meanings.note: Qualitative or relational adjective formed with the productive '-н-' suffix, meaning 'safe' and agreeing in gender, number, and case.

meanings.note: Declinable neuter noun meaning 'dish', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.
Secondary conversational sense ('platter') (large flat serving dish) used in spoken Russian dialogue.

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.

meanings.note: Used in Russian as a perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to appear', forming an aspectual pair with 'браться'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.
